{{Quote|Trust me, the ScragHull's pilots are stardust. I see no reason to delay repairs, and since I am the captain of the ''Ormni''&mdash;''"<br />"''Don't make me relieve you. Trust me, Captain Palis, you wouldn't like that. Are we clear?|Palis and Savara Raine|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
'''Palis''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the corporation [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]] as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''[[Ormni]]'', an [[asteroid crusher]] that operated in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]].<ref name="Crucible" />
 
In [[45 ABY]], a [[ScragHull commando boat]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] crashed into the ''Ormni'', coming to rest wrecked within the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] production vault. Palis, concerned that repairs would halt production and cost hundreds of millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in lost revenue, assumed the Jedi had [[Death/Legends|perished]] when the impact detonated the ScragHull's [[Fusion generator/Legends|fusion core]]. He ordered [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to decontaminate and secure the vault. GET security chief [[Vestara Khai|Savara Raine]], however, criticised him for failing to search for survivors&mdash;pointing to evidence that Skywalker and Organa Solo had in fact survived the crash.<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Palis appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
